{{Quote|I have read the Ithor Outreach anthropological narratives from before the war; the inventiveness and spirit of the tree-dwelling Nilash natives is inspiring and their ability to form telepathic group minds is remarkable. Has Daiman preserved anything of their culture? Nilash is a known source of anthracite and Daiman would surely raze its jungles to build war factories.|[[Vannar Treece]]|<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />}}
'''Nilash III''', also called simply '''Nilash''',<ref name="Aflame 5" /> was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Nilash system/Legends|Nilash system]], located close to the [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]-rich planet [[Chelloa]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> It was home to a [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-dwelling, [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] [[Unidentified Nilash species|native]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and a known source of [[anthracite]]. During the [[New Sith Wars]] the jungle-covered planet housed a [[Daimanate|Daimanite]] munitions plant while, under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Nilash Imperial Impound Facility]] was established in an orbit around the world. It was on this world that the later-famous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], at the time known as the ''Second Chance'', first came into [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] possession. During the following years, the control over Nilash was repeatedly transferred between the Empire and Rebellion's respective incarnations.

==History==
===New Sith Wars===
{{Quote|That's why the administrator here called, my Creator. Someone entered the munitions plant and freed the native workers last night. We believe the slaves simply melted back into the jungle.''"<br />"''No agent of Odion's would free slaves. Was anything missing?''"<br />"''Only a single high-powered laser, my lord, designed for cutting cortosis. It's hard to see the strategic importance.''"<br />"''It's a ''message''. ''To me''. She wants me to know - ''she exists''. She exists - and she's not going away...|[[Uleeta]] and [[Daiman]], upon inspecting the damage caused by [[Kerra Holt]]|<ref name="Aflame 5" />}}
At some point before or during the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Ithor Outreach]] carried out [[Sentientologist|anthropological]] studies on the [[Unidentified Nilash species|native]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-dwelling [[Species/Legends|species]] and reported their findings in narratives.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

Later, during the [[Second Charge Matrica|conflict]] between [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]], Nilash III was a part of Daiman's [[Daimanate|territory]] and housed a munitions factory where the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] natives were forced to work.<ref name="Aflame 5" /><ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

[[File:Nilash_Daimanite_munitions_plant.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Daimanate|Daimanite]] munitions plant.]]

Shortly before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Operation Influx]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] compiled a report for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]] on the worlds of the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] and included in it a brief description of Nilash III and its natives, whose inventiveness and spirit he described as "inspiring" and telepathic ability as "remarkable".<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

After the disastrous Jedi mission<ref name="Aflame 1">[[Knight Errant 1|''Knight Errant'' 1]]</ref> and the subsequent [[Destruction of Chelloa|devastation]]<ref name="Aflame 5" /> of the [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]-rich Daimanite planet [[Chelloa]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] visited Nilash and [[Raid on Nilash III|freed]] the native slave workers, who disappeared in the surrounding jungle. In addition to that, since Daiman had ordered that all of his statues throughout his [[Daimanate|realm]] be coated with [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] plating due to Holt decapitating more than a dozen of them on Chelloa as a sign of defiance and warning,<ref name="Aflame 4">[[Knight Errant 4|''Knight Errant'' 4]]</ref> the young Jedi also appropriated from the weapons plant a high-powered [[Laser/Legends|laser]], designed for cutting cortosis, and used it to remove the heads of thirteen statues that were located in a small plaza at the complex. On the notice of the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the munitions plant, Daiman himself arrived on the planet, where, together with his [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Uleeta]], he inspected the damage and interpreted the act of vandalism as a message that Holt "existed" and was "not going away".<ref name="Aflame 5" />

Five to six weeks later,<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://scifi.about.com/od/starwarspeople/a/Interview-With-John-Jackson-Miller_2.htm|text=John Jackson Miller interview with About.com]</ref> when the [[Odionate|Odionite]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] was sent to Daiman's capital world of [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]|work=a [[Mission to Darkknell (New Sith Wars)|mission]] to destroy the [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility]], he made up a cover identity of a machine tool operator transferred from Nilash.<REMOVE>}}
<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>

During the [[Light and Darkness War|war]] between the Republic and the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] led by Sith Lord [[Skere Kaan|Kaan]] three decades later, Nilash III was still located in Sith space.<ref name="TEA" />

===Clone Wars and early Imperial Period===
{{Expandsect}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Grumani sector, including Nilash III, was under the control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="RepHNNCE 15:01:03" />

[[File:Melfal.jpg|150px|thumb|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Second Chance'']], which was liberated from the [[Nilash Imperial Impound Facility]].]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], it was the site of the [[Nilash Imperial Impound Facility]], an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] impound yard. In [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Second Chance'']], later known as the ''Millennium Falcon'', was liberated from Nilash III by the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Zenn Bien]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents [[Quip Fargil]] and [[Luufkin]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />

===Galactic Civil War===
Shortly after the death of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a large portion of the Grumani sector, including Sanrafsix, came under the control of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]]'s recently-formed Imperial faction, the [[Eriadu Authority]]. His rule proved to be short, however, since in [[5 ABY/Legends|the following year]] the nascent [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Sanrafsix (Galactic Civil War)|recaptured]] [[Sanrafsix/Legends|Sanrafsix]] and the rest of the sector.<ref name="TEA" />

When the Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] returned to the known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] and began his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] of conquest, the Grumani sector either was conquered or allied itself with Thrawn's forces.<ref name="TEA" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
The Grumani sector, Nilash included, remained unscathed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] that ravaged the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] from [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
